response: Staging laparoscopy in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) has a limited benefit. According to the available data, the overall yield of staging laparoscopy (SL) for HCC is 7%, and the accuracy is 27%. This suggests that SL may not be a highly effective tool for staging HCC, especially when accurate imaging methods and percutaneous liver biopsy are already being used as part of the preoperative workup. In such cases, the benefit of SL may be further reduced. Therefore, the usefulness of staging laparoscopy in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma is questionable, and its application should be carefully considered in the context of other diagnostic tools and procedures.
